# Faisal Mehmood - Senior Backend Engineer & Framework Architect

## Profile
Senior Full Stack Engineer with over 5 years of experience building enterprise web platforms and developer tooling.
Lead architect of Nextly, an MIT-licensed Next.js CMS framework published on npm.
Currently leading backend architecture for a team of 8 engineers across 7 production environments serving 50K+ users.
Based in Haripur, KPK, Pakistan.

## Skills
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn/UI
- **Backend**: Node.js, NestJS, Express.js, Python, FastAPI, GraphQL, REST APIs
- **Database**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, SQLite, Redis, Drizzle ORM, SQLAlchemy
- **CMS**: Nextly (lead architect), Payload CMS, Strapi, WordPress (VIP, Headless, Custom Themes, Gutenberg)
- **DevOps**: Docker, AWS, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Coolify, Hetzner VPS
- **Auth & Security**: JWT, OAuth 2.0, RBAC, Field-level Permissions

## Projects
- **Nextly Framework**: MIT-licensed, TypeScript-native Next.js CMS and app framework (nextlyhq.com).
- **Rext AI**: Multi-tenant content automation SaaS (Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL).
- **4RE Marketing Console**: Marketing console and API backend for 4 Rivers Equipment (NestJS, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL).
- **21st Century & 4 Rivers Equipment**: Headless Next.js e-commerce platforms with Stripe payments.
- **PCI Security Standards Council**: Enterprise WordPress VIP multisite, multi-language platform.
- **The National Pulse**: High-traffic news platform with Stripe subscriptions (WordPress).
- **Enterprise Data Pipeline**: Airbyte connectors for logging/sentry service (Python).
- **SmartCourse AI**: AI course recommendation engine (Python, Flask, Sentence Transformers).
